newsitem.title: TAIWAN: CPC shuts No.4 cracker for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: CPC shuts No.4 cracker for maintenance.

text.p: Taiwan's state oil monopoly Chinese Petroleum Corp on Friday shut its No. 4 naphtha cracker for 60 days of annual maintenance, but its petrochemical products' supplies would not be hurt, company officials said.
"The No.4 naphtha cracker starts its 60 days of annual maintenance today, but all products supplies will remain normal," a company official said.
CPC's No.2 cracking plant was shut down in April 1994 after the firm opened a No. 5 cracker. CPC closed its No. 1 cracker in 1990.
The No. 3, No. 4 and No. 5 crackers have annual capacities of 230,000, 385,000 and 400,000 tonnes of ethylene respectively.
